messages:
katie: Heads up — seeing a spike of GPU Pending in eu-west1 for the last 30m after the new rack came up. Small pods piling up and we just triggered an eviction wave in the shared pools.
ben: Any quick signal? grafana link or scheduler logs?
katie: grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/xyz -> pending pods up 3x, avg wait ~2m. Scheduler log snippet: ```I0321 12:02:11 scheduler.go:423] packer: fallback to stripe-cohort for pod job-123; evicted=47 reason=taint/affinity-mismatch```
carla: this smells like hetero-profile mixing (A100 vs cheaper A10x-like SKU). New rack nodes got the wrong label set, packer is scattering pods across incompatible cohorts so we fragment and then preempt/backfill. Warm pool also has a label mismatch so it doesn't satisfy tiny-gang placements.
sam: can we quick-mitigate by preferring same-flavor packing and scaling warmpool up in eu-west1? Proposed small change: ```scheduler.config.packing.preference = "flavor-same" warmpool.eu-west1.size += 20```. I'll canary deploy to one AZ.
katie: cost note — if warmpool size +20 runs for 2 hours we're looking at ~+12% hourly GPU spend in the region, but it'll reduce evictions. Current eviction churn is also causing throttled retries and extra egress to storage (adds cost).
dmitri: long-term we should add shape-aware scoring and extend lease TTL so short-lived preempts don't churn (lease_ttl -> 10m). Also double-check node-init job that sets labels; I saw a KMS timeout yesterday that delayed node-agent labeling which left nodes temporarily tainted.
ben: @sam can you run the canary now? capture scheduler metrics + pending count. If warmpool fix drops pending by >60% in 15m we promote.
sam: running canary in eu-west1a now. will post results. deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: warmpool-scale eu-west1a (+20) by sam — id cly-352.
sam: canary results after 7m: pending reduced 65%, eviction rate down to baseline. No regressions.
dmitri: opened issue #INFRA-1298 with long-term plan: shape-aware binpacking, lease TTL bump, node-init labeling retry backoff.
katie: thanks all. If pending doesn't fall below 20 pods in 45m we revert. otherwise we'll promote the warmpool scaling region-wide. :thumbsup:
ben: ack, monitor and alerting updated (rule: pending_gpu_over_30m > 30 -> pager).
